settings.heading: Ireland's CarPlay and car audio specialist
settings.text:
At MG Car Audio we make the car you already love feel brand new inside. From Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on your factory screen to widescreen upgrades and premium sound, we bring the latest in-car technology to your dashboard with a clean, factory-quality finish.

We specialise in CarPlay and screen installations for BMW and Mercedes-Benz, and we upgrade Audi, Volkswagen and all major makes too.

settings.heading: Every drive should feel like a concert
settings.text:
We're a Dublin car audio and in-car technology team dedicated to one thing: a better drive. Our range includes trusted brands such as JBL and Harman Kardon.

Quality you can see and hear. Clear product information, honest advice and installations tailored to your car.

You come first. We keep improving what we offer so our products and service don't just meet your expectations, they exceed them.
